messages:
Nadia S.: Noticing a spike in resume attempts from EU edge starting ~10:02 UTC. Clients see immediate reconnects after a read timeout. quota burn panels jump.
Ravi K.: Yep. Console trace shows proxy read-timeout followed by N clients each opening new SSE streams instantly. No client jitter.
Min-ji Lee: Repro snippet from proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-23T10:02:11Z] proxy.eu1: read timeout=30000ms session=xyz
[2026-03-23T10:02:11Z] proxy.eu1: send close event EOF
[2026-03-23T10:02:11Z] api.eu1: resume request client_id=42 route=/v1/stream
```
Clients: reconnect x20 within 1s window.
Omar (oncall): This caused two customers to hit emergency throttles. We need either server-side smoothing or force clients to back off. Can we avoid a long rollout?
Nadia S.: Quick mitigation idea: send a soft-close SSE event before terminating so well-behaved SDKs can jitter. e.g. `event: _hint
data: {"retry_ms":1200, "reason":"read_timeout"}

` then close. Tag telemetry with `reconnect_hint=soft` and `reconnect_reason=read_timeout`.
Ravi K.: Sending a hint makes sense. We should also expose an HTTP header for non-SSE clients: `X-Stream-Hint: retry_ms=1200`. Also capture whether the client actually delayed by adding `client_backoff_applied=true|false` to resume logs.
Min-ji Lee: Minimal feature flag config I mocked:
```
edge.sse.hint_on_timeout = true
edge.sse.hint.retry_ms = 1200
edge.sse.hint.rollout_pct = 10
```
If false, behave as today. If true, emit `_hint` and close.
Omar (oncall): Fine, but we need to avoid false negatives in alerts. Can we add a temporary alert suppression: ignore short spikes if a majority of reconnections were hinted?
Nadia S.: Yes. Plan: alert suppression window 10m if `telemetry.hint_fraction > 0.6` for a route. Also create dashboard panels showing hinted vs immediate reconnections and per-minute token burn.
ci-bot: Deploy queued: branch sse-soft-hint (CI: pass) :rocket:
Ravi K.: SDK side: we'll add `_hint` handler to official JS and Python SDKs to parse retry_ms and apply jitter (uniform 1x-2.5x) and start exponential backoff after 4 immediate reconnects. We'll emit metric `sdk_backoff_applied` on first delayed reconnect.
Min-ji Lee: Add telemetry keys: `hint_emitted=true`, `hint_retry_ms=1200`, `client_backoff=true/false`. We can then run a quick query to measure adoption.
Omar (oncall): During rollout, if adoption < 40% after 24h, fallback mitigation: server-side queueing that accepts resumes but delays session bind by 800-1500ms for same source IP for next 60s. But that's last resort.
Nadia S.: Rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% over 48h, monitor: `sdk_backoff_applied` rate, `hint_applied_fraction`, and route token burn. Gate progress on hint_applied_fraction >= 0.5 at each step.
Ravi K.: I'll open SDK PRs and attach here. Include tests that simulate immediate reconnect loops and show metric toggles.
Min-ji Lee: I'll submit proxy PR behind feature flag and add console toggle per-route for enabling hinting. Need owners review.
Omar (oncall): I'll update the incident playbook to mention `soft_hint` and suppression rules. Also add a temporary dashboard alert for clients failing to apply hints (low `sdk_backoff_applied`).
Nadia S.: Great. If staging metrics look reasonable, we'll ship to EU next. Ping #incidents if anything noisy during rollout.
Ravi K.: Linking draft SDK PR: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/999 (WIP)
Min-ji Lee: Pushing proxy branch now.
ci-bot: staging deploy started for sse-soft-hint branch (staging/edge) :construction:
Omar (oncall): Thanks team.
